<!MissingKey:1497:一. 全新关卡：>:
1. New Levels:
Challenge Mode is now available, with new challenge levels for Wild Gatling Pea, Queen Sunflower, and Ice Tall-nut.
2. New Plants:
Gatling Pot has been added as a purple upgrade card. Clear Wild Gatling Pea Challenge 3 to unlock it. The Shop now sells a new purple upgrade card: Frostfire Pumpkin.
3. Gameplay Changes:
None.
4. New Costumes:
The Shop now sells costumes for Red-eye-shroom, Scorching Lily Pad, Queen Sunflower, and Wild Gatling Pea. Pea Lily Pad, Sea-nut, Spiked Melon-pult, and Ice Torchwood have been added as September Daily Challenge costume rewards.
5. New Zombies and Armor Variants:
Gatling Dolphin Rider, Snorkel Dolphin Zombie, Duck Rider Zombie, Entangled Snorkel Zombie, Cat Warrior Zombie, and Siren Zombie have been added. New armor variants are also available for Snorkel Dolphin Zombie, Siren Zombie, and Entangled Snorkel Zombie.
(If the game stutters, try lowering the frame-rate limit.)
6. Optimizations and Bug Fixes:
Text descriptions have been improved throughout the game.
Multiple bugs reported by players have been fixed. If you encounter an unresolved bug, please report it in the official community group as soon as possible.
The next update is coming soon. Stay tuned!

It's still the story of Plants vs. Zombies—but this time, you're the zombies!
Welcome to I, Zombie Adventure.

The trial is about to begin. A Peashooter will appear and continuously attack your Target Zombie.
If the plants defeat even one Target Zombie, you lose.
